releaseNotes:
• Apple-style fluid bottom navigation: Fluid sliding pill capsule with velocity stretch & snap physics, subtle icon spring bounces, and tactile haptics
• Critical Event Details fix: Resolved routing deadlock and blank screen on event details with in-memory caching and 3-tier catalog fallback
• Security Hardening: Removed hardcoded secrets, secured dotenv initialization, and guarded dev bypasses in release mode
• Multi-cloud storage: Supabase Storage integration with Cloudflare R2 CDN resilience
• Modular architecture: Decomposed Event Details and AI Announcement Studio into clean, decoupled components
• Visual polish: Animated Material 3 Expressive pulsing shimmer skeletons
